bio: Trafford Hall Hotel is an imposing Victorian building which was originally the Trafford Public Hall. Following an extensive renovation and refurbishment, Trafford Hall is now a 4-star boutique hotel.  Afternoon Tea is served in Signature Steakhouse, where you can choose a Classic Afternoon Tea, or an Indian Afternoon Tea menu.  Classic Afternoon Tea includes a selection of finger sandwiches, fruit scones with clotted cream & strawberry preserve and an assortment of mini cakes, served with tea or coffee.  Indian Afternoon Tea features chicken tikka sandwiches, a selection of mini Indian savouries and desserts, including Gajar halva cake, plus sultana scones with clotted cream & strawberry preserve. Masala Chai and hot chocolate are available as well as tea and coffee.  Add a touch of fizz to your Afternoon Tea by adding a glass of Prosecco or a cocktail  Trafford Hall Hotel is located close to Old Trafford and easily accessible from many of Manchester’s major transport links.
